# funkbox

> Local creative tools for Claude and other MCP clients: seamless GPU-shader loops, layered posters with exact
> text, FastSD text-to-image and img2img, and product / app video ads in 9:16, 16:9 or both from one edit (stills,
> clips, screen recordings with push-ins; captions, voiceover, music on a beat grid, end card) whose copy is locked
> to what the user approved. One MCP server (`funkbox`, 51 tools) and one CLI
> (`python -m funkbox`). Runs on OpenGL 3.3 (Intel iGPU is fine); no cloud, accounts or NVIDIA GPU. MIT.

Install from a clone with `python install.py --with reel --register desktop` (or `--register code`), or as a Claude
Code plugin: `/plugin install funkbox --marketplace IsraelWebDev/funkbox`. Tool names start with the area:
`loop_`, `reel_`, `project_`, `poster_`, `image_`, `apps_`. Never write copy.json yourself: propose wording with
`project_propose_copy`, and the user approves it with `project_approve_copy`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/README.md): what it makes, with example prompts
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install, verify and uninstall on Windows, macOS and Linux
- [Tool catalog](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/docs/catalog.json): every tool's name, area, description and input schema, generated from the MCP server (`python -m funkbox catalog`)
- [Plan-driven renders (proposed)](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox-online/blob/main/docs/adr-plan-driven-renders.md): how the website will plan a render from this catalog
- [Skill: driving the tools](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/skills/funk-studio/SKILL.md): the workflow an agent should follow
- [Loops](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/docs/loops.md): shader contract, recipes, presets
- [Ads](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/docs/reel.md): shot lists, projects, the copy lock
- [Posters and edits](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/docs/stills.md)
- [FastSD and GIMP](https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox/blob/main/docs/studio.md)
